title: Capitalization of Initialisms
summary: Guidelines for capitalizing initialisms and acronyms in camelCase identifiers, recommending initial-cap style (XmlHttpRequest) over all-caps (XMLHTTPRequest) to improve readability, consistency, and automated code transformations.
when-to-read: You're designing naming conventions for code or establishing style guidelines for identifiers containing acronyms and initialisms. This article is distinct from general code-quality discussions on naming—consult the broader code-quality tag if you need guidance on naming conventions that aren't specifically about acronym capitalization.
